recommended_first_discriminator: One plain no-argument df on a read-only PMBLUE mount; locally retain output and completion while passively capturing its TCP flow.
avoid: df -P or df -i (skip FAT free scan)
limits: Different from allocation: no modulo search, allocation lock, metadata writes or cache-policy flush.
A whole-FAT scan is longer in entry count and cache state may differ.
df main ignores df_fat failure; require expected FAT row/counts and clean diagnostics, not only exit0.
Success cannot disprove allocation-specific interruption; passive correlation cannot uniquely prove cause.
